# Dr Oracle

> > Dr Oracle provides privacy-focused web analytics solutions as a modern alternative to traditional analytics platforms.

Dr Oracle leverages Plausible Analytics to offer lightweight, privacy-friendly web analytics. The platform emphasizes open-source principles and provides users with a transparent alternative to Google Analytics and other data-heavy analytics tools.

## Key Topics

- Plausible Analytics
- Web Analytics
- Privacy-Friendly
- Google Analytics Alternative
- Lightweight
- Open-Source
- Data Privacy
- Analytics Platform

## Analytics Platform

- [Plausible · Web Analytics](https://analytics.droracle.ai/): Privacy-friendly, lightweight alternative to Google Analytics with open-source principles
